Class BudgetCycle

java.lang.Object
com.model.BudgetCycle
public class BudgetCycle extends Object
Represents a budget cycle in the Masroofy application. A budget cycle defines a time period with a total spending allowance, and tracks the remaining balance and safe daily spending limit.

    • BudgetCycle

      public BudgetCycle(int cycleId, double totalAllowance, LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate)
      Constructs a BudgetCycle with the specified parameters. Initializes the remaining balance to the total allowance and sets the daily limit to zero.
      Parameters:
      cycleId - the unique ID for this cycle
      totalAllowance - the total spending allowance
      startDate - the start date of the cycle
      endDate - the end date of the cycle

    • getRemainingDays

      public int getRemainingDays()
      Calculates the number of days remaining in this budget cycle, inclusive of today. Returns 0 if the cycle has already ended, or the full duration if it hasn't started yet.
      Returns:
      the number of remaining days as an integer

    • isExpired

      public boolean isExpired()
      Checks whether this budget cycle has expired (i.e. the end date has passed).
      Returns:
      true if today is after the end date, false otherwise
